channel.title: Pier & Point · Pier 70 Parcel E4
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 70 Parcel E4 (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel E4: The 2026-10-06 entry for this record said the 2042 date comes from the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance. That was wrong. The Port's 2017 staff report (Item 9B, p.7) puts the Schedule of Performance in the Disposition and Development Agreement (DDA) between the Port and the developer, which is a different agreement from the Development Agreement between the City and the developer. The report says the developer must complete phase 3 within approximately 25 years of project approval, but it never states the year 2042; 2042 is Pier & Point's own arithmetic (2017 plus 25 years). It stays labelled a legal outside date, not an expected completion.

The Port's 2017 staff report calls it an outside date in the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance (Phase 3 within approximately 25 years of approval), not a construction schedule. item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel E4: Parcel E4's completion milestone now reflects that the 2017 DDA lists the Arts Building with Phase 3 items tied to the office building on Parcel B-2, not Phase 2, and the year shown is only a soft placeholder because DDA dates are tolled and being reset. The map notes now give the D4D's designation (retail, arts and light industrial, with upper-floor office allowed) instead of 'Arts only', cite Port Item 12B for the 'arts building parcel' wording, drop an uncited brochure and a generic ground-condition list, and no longer claim the site was never subdivided by the Assessor. The Item 11A milestones are dated to the Aug 7, 2026 staff report, and image credits and licence notes no longer say 'adopted' where the source doesn't. The D4D citation no longer calls it an 'adopted' document, and the Mayor's signing entry now states the Board of Supervisors' first-reading vote on Oct 31, 2017 and final passage on Nov 14, 2017.

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel E4: No completion date is sourced for the Arts Building on E4. The DDA lists it among Phase 3 items (Port Item 9B, Table A, p.8: VDDA no later than the TCO for Building B2; Table 3: construction within three years after completing the office building on Parcel B-2), while the Port's proposed 2026 phasing plan groups E4 with E1 and Building 21 in subphase 2C. 2042 is shown only as the outermost bound: Pier & Point's arithmetic for the DDA's Phase 3 outside date (approximately 25 years after Project approval; the Port's report states no calendar year) (~2042)
